text.title: One day at Meteora for 41 euros

cafe.name: Qastiro, the old Kastraki square
cafe.order: coffee on the terrace with the rocks overhead
cafe.when: an all-day bistro; go before the 9am monastery opening

dish.name: païdákia, charcoal lamb ribs
dish.tip: Grilled plates come with chips and rice; open from noon

spot.name: Varlaam Monastery
spot.how: the stone stairway cut up from the road

items: Lamb ribs and a Greek salad at Xarama — €28

text.mistake: Every gate is cash only — no card machines anywhere — and each monastery shuts a different weekday. Grand Meteoron closes Tuesdays, and the nearest ATM is down in Kalambaka.
text.close: Send this to whoever forgets the dress code
